_comment: A duplicate of an earlier result, replayed. The row is no longer IN_CALL, so PrepCheck refuses to apply it a second time and holds the patient for review. Without this check a replayed webhook would advance the follow-up counter and schedule another call to a real person.
_matching: Replace REPLACE_WITH_call_id_FROM_SHEET with the value in the row's call_id column after placing a dry-run call. A result that cannot be matched to the call in flight is held for review rather than applied.
